scope: Full-interface replica of the Student Progress screen (expanded state: Arjun Mehta open). Every UI element with a verified registry mapping is a published library component instance — 49 in total. Container frames (page section, roster card, table rows) are auto-layout frames with design-system variables bound for colour, spacing, radius and stroke; no raw hex or px values. Nothing was drawn to imitate a component that the library lacks.

variantGaps.reason: The Figma set exposes primary | secondary | tertiary | danger | success | warning | socio-emotional | mastering content | advocacy | relationships | technology tools — there is no `info` variant, though the code Badge has one.
variantGaps.action: Session outcome "Steady" placed as style=primary. Same substitution as the tutor-payout-history write-back; needs a real `info` variant in the Figma set.

gaps.reason: The published Page Layout component (key 4d02ef5dbb2961127c21f11cb05384d17482841f) contains Top Bar + Main Container + a Content SLOT but NO Sidebar, so an instance of it cannot reproduce the rendered shell. The registry's node-id for PageLayout (111:241933) also does not resolve in the file the registry names (zAecJNRdvJzAUOcjV32tRX) — the specs live in the separate 'Design System - Web App Specs' library.
gaps.action: Shell composed from its registry-mapped parts instead — Sidebar (122:1110) + Top Bar (122:1112), both real library instances. Registry entry for PageLayout needs its fileKey/node-id corrected and the published component needs its Sidebar restored.

gaps.reason: The DS Card component (4241:27817) has a fixed internal structure (image / title / subtitle / content / list / link / button) and exposes no content SLOT, so a Table cannot be nested inside a Card instance.
gaps.action: Roster container built as an auto-layout frame with Card/pad-x-lg, Card/pad-y-lg, Card/radius-md, Card/border-sm and surface-container-lowest / outline-variant bound — the Card's own tokens, no invented values. A slot-bearing Card variant would close this.

gaps.reason: No design-system component expresses a table row that expands in place; the code composes it from Table + an injected colSpan row.
gaps.action: Reproduced as a sibling frame directly beneath the open row, tinted surface-container-high with an Element/stroke-lg primary left accent — matching the code's .sp__detail-cell / .sp__history styling.

notPlaced.element: Demo state switch (Assigned students / No students)
notPlaced.reason: Prototype-only scaffolding, marked 'not a shipped control' in prototypes/student-progress/student-progress-manifest.json. Excluded so the frame reads as the product interface.
A separate screen state; this frame replicates the populated + expanded state. Would need its own [replica] frame.

divergences.detail: The published Figma Sidebar ships 'Slack' as its second Toolkit item; the code Sidebar renders 'Reviews'. Overridden to 'Reviews' in the instance to match the rendered interface — the underlying component still differs.
DS body cells centre their text; the rendered app left-aligns. Applied as an instance-level textAlignHorizontal override on 30 cell text nodes.

verification.method: All placed via importComponentSetByKeyAsync/importComponentByKeyAsync + createInstance — published library instances only. No capture-based authoring tool was used at any point in producing this frame.
verification.visualCheck: Frame screenshot compared against the running prototype at localhost:3050 (expanded state, Arjun Mehta open); no placeholder text remains (audited for 'Table Head', 'Table Body', 'Badge', 'Button', 'John Doe', 'Strategies', 'Page Now').
